chunks: Mubārak al-‘Aqarqūfī narrated from Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā ibn Ja‘far, peace be upon them both, who said:
"Zakat was instituted as sustenance for the poor and as a means of preserving their wealth."

key_terms.تَوْفِيرًا: a means of preserving or increasing

ai.seo_question: Why was zakat made obligatory in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states that zakat was ordained to provide sustenance for the poor and to preserve wealth. It highlights the social and economic wisdom behind zakat as an obligation within Islam.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1575 - Mubarak Al-Aqrqoufi narrated from Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) who said:
"Zakat was established as sustenance for the poor and a means of increasing their wealth."
